tasks.description: Predict the growth stage of rice based on soil moisture, temperature, and NPK levels using a lightweight decision tree model.
Compute the Temperature-Humidity Index (THI) from ambient temperature and humidity to assess crop stress conditions.
Evaluate soil fertility using the Soil Fertility Index (SFI) derived from organic matter percentage and NPK levels.
Monitor water usage efficiency by calculating the ratio of crop yield to water consumption based on irrigation frequency and rainfall data.
Detect early signs of pest pressure using a threshold-based alert system for the Pest_Pressure index.
